title: ScriptCraft v0.4: structure and collaboration (PR #47)
sub: Every frame is the real app, driven through its own menus, keys and clicks

title: #26  New from Template: TV sitcom / multi-camera
sub: File > New from Template. Our own templates: single-camera, multi-camera, stage play

title: #26  Multi-camera format
sub: Scene letters, action in capitals, double-spaced dialogue, every act and scene on a new page

type: Ray stirs a huge pot of sauce.
Who ate the meatballs? I counted them. There were forty.

title: #21  Structure points: acts and sequences
sub: Kept on the scene headings; they survive scene moves, undo, FDX and Fountain

params.title: The Mayday
params.summary: A voice breaks through the static.

title: #21  Outline view: drag a scene under another act
sub: Drag a row by its grip; the wheelhouse scene moves from Act Two into Act One

title: #23  Story map: scenes and acts against page count
sub: View > Story Map docks a strip at the bottom; click a block to go there

title: #28  Split screen: outline beside the page
sub: View > Split Screen > Side by Side. Each pane has its own view and scroll; one caret

title: #22  Beat board: free-form cards before they become scenes
sub: Text, colour and position; pan, zoom, drag; saved with the script

title: #22  Link a beat to a scene, then jump to it
sub: Right-click a card: Link to Scene, Go to Scene, New Scene from Beat

title: #28  Bookmarks in the navigator
sub: Navigator Bookmarks tab (or Edit > Bookmarks); a bookmark follows its paragraph through edits and undo

point.text: Then we do it the old way

title: #24  Track changes, per author
sub: Tools > Track Changes. Insertions are underlined in the author's colour

type: Not tonight. Not on my watch.

title: #24  Accept or reject: one change, all, or one author's
sub: Tools > Track Changes > Show Changes. Deleted text stays visible, struck through

title: #24  Compare two drafts by element
sub: Tools > Compare with Draft: changed, moved, added and removed paragraphs, with a word diff

title: #27  Read aloud with a voice per character
sub: Offline system voices (say, System.Speech, espeak-ng); voices are saved with the script

title: #27  Dictation: spoken phrases become script
sub: Tools > Dictation. Feed it OS dictation, whisper.cpp, the browser, or an agent
